purpose: PET4D adds DICOM plugins that load gated, dynamic and static PET series as sequences in SUV or Bq/ml. It also adds modules for frame review/editing, motion correction, PET-to-CT/MR registration (BRAINSFit and SimpleITK) and kinetic modelling (1TC, 2TC, Patlak, Logan, SRTM, SUVR), for nuclear-medicine researchers.
summary: I read the catalog entry, both CMake files, the LICENSE and the modelling, settings, plot and settings-library code. I also ran searches over the whole source. I found no network access, subprocess calls, pip installs, eval/exec, pickle or downloads. File writes go only to user-chosen CSV paths, temporary DICOM export folders that are cleaned up, and the DICOM database after an explicit export. The license is MIT. EXTENSION_DEPENDS "NA" matches an empty build_dependencies list, and the Python files that are not listed in the plugin's script list are installed by their own module macros. Remaining points are minor: the revision is the moving branch "main", the plugin confidence of 1.05 outranks other loaders, and the 1.5 MB module icon is large. I did not read every file.
